install_hints.Darwin: Install Python 3.11 or newer from python.org or with pyenv.
install_hints.Linux: Install Python 3.11 or newer with your distribution package manager.

install_hints.Darwin: Install FFmpeg with `brew install ffmpeg` or another trusted package source.
install_hints.Linux: Install the ffmpeg package with your distribution package manager.

install_hints.Darwin: Install the Xcode command-line tools or Git from a trusted package source.
install_hints.Linux: Install Git with your distribution package manager.

install_hints.Darwin: Agent runner isolation requires the sandbox-exec command supplied by macOS.

install_hints.Linux: Install the bubblewrap package to run packet/response agents with network and host writes denied.

install_hints.Darwin: Install current Node.js LTS from nodejs.org or with a version manager.
install_hints.Linux: Install current Node.js LTS from nodejs.org or with a version manager.

install_hints.Darwin: Install Graphviz with `brew install graphviz` when lineage or arrangement maps are wanted.
install_hints.Linux: Install the graphviz package with your distribution package manager.

install_hints.default: Run `make visuals-install` from the repository root.
Use `./scripts/eprs chatcut prepare ...` to build a disposable local package. ChatCut sign-in and remote submission remain explicitly user-operated.

install_hints.Darwin: Install Shotcut from shotcut.org for account-free local timeline editing.

Use an isolated ACE-Step 1.5 environment only after checking hardware: accelerated macOS packages require Apple Silicon; Intel Macs should use an explicitly operated remote sidecar or accept slow CPU inference.
install_hints.Linux: Use the official isolated ACE-Step 1.5 environment after checking GPU, VRAM, disk, model license, and output-rights requirements.

install_hints.Darwin: Create an isolated Python 3.11+ environment and install `qwen-tts`; add `pyworld` for optional formant-aware pitch processing; use the project runner for local voice design or custom-voice generation.
install_hints.Linux: Create an isolated Python 3.11+ environment and install `qwen-tts`; add `pyworld` for optional formant-aware pitch processing; use the project runner for local voice design or custom-voice generation.

install_hints.Darwin: Use an isolated Python 3.10+ environment under `.eprs-local/raon-opentts-env`, clone the official Raon-OpenTTS checkout under `.eprs-local/raon-opentts`, install its dependencies, download the 1B checkpoint and 16 kHz HiFi-GAN vocoder, and review the CC-BY-NC-4.0 model terms before use.
install_hints.Linux: Use the official isolated Raon-OpenTTS environment after checking accelerator memory, checkpoint/vocoder disk space, reference-voice consent, and the CC-BY-NC-4.0 model terms.

install_hints.default: Use the project runner with explicit permission for remote processing; the reference-free Voice Design lane needs no local model install or human voice upload.

install_hints.Darwin: This Mac cannot run the official CUDA checkpoint locally; operate a separate CUDA sidecar and set EPRS_MINIMAX_MUSIC3_URL.
install_hints.Linux: Use the official MiniMax Music 3 CUDA/SGLang-Omni setup after checking GPU memory, disk, license, and output disclosure requirements.

install_hints.default: Use the public Hugging Face Space or an explicitly operated sidecar for one bounded sketch; quota, model revision, and output evidence must be recorded before local mixing.

install_hints.Darwin: Use an isolated Seed-VC environment on Apple Silicon; keep source vocals immutable and record model, steps, backend, and rights.
install_hints.Linux: Use the official Seed-VC environment after checking accelerator, model, and output-rights requirements.

install_hints.default: Install OpenVPI dataset-tools or GAME in an isolated environment only when a note-extraction experiment is explicitly requested.
Install an explicitly selected DiffSinger model and vocoder in isolation; verify each model license before any public or monetized release.
Keep Vevo1.5 as an opt-in experimental project; its model stack is large and must be tested on the available hardware before use.
Install Basic Pitch in an isolated environment for one-instrument or animal-call pitch studies; do not treat MIDI extraction as a finished arrangement.
Install Demucs only for reversible stem experiments; preserve the parent mix and record bleed, artifacts, model, and license.

install_hints.Darwin: Install Audacity if hands-on recording or waveform editing is wanted.
Install Sonic Pi if coded synthesis, samples, MIDI, Ableton Link, local OSC, or session recording is wanted.

workflows.label: Daily agent work
workflows.description: Claim due local work, prepare verified bounded context, and preserve result evidence; launching remains a separate explicit isolated-runner action.

workflows.label: Isolated local agent runner
workflows.description: Run one explicit shell-free packet/response profile with OS-enforced network denial, workspace-only host writes, bounded logs, a deadline, and a preserved receipt.

workflows.label: Performed beat idea to reviewed groove
workflows.description: Observe a spoken or played beat without assigning roles, author one explicit drummer-facing interpretation, and audition it as a review-gated BeatScript prototype.

workflows.label: Optional local generative-music collaboration
workflows.description: Hand an owned prompt, lyrics, or reference recording to an explicitly operated local generator and return new audio plus exact model, seed, settings, rights, and listening evidence.

workflows.label: Optional local voice generation
workflows.description: Generate bounded original speech or character voice cues locally, optionally apply declared formant-aware pitch treatment, then preserve raw audio, exact model, prompt, seed, controls, output, and rights evidence.

workflows.label: Optional consented local reference-voice speech generation
workflows.description: Generate short English speech cues from an explicitly consented reference voice with a local Raon-OpenTTS checkpoint; preserve the reference transcript, consent note, model/license evidence, and separate pitch treatment. This workflow does not claim singing synthesis.

workflows.label: Optional remote reference-free voice generation
workflows.description: Generate bounded original speech cues through an explicitly authorized remote voice-design service, preserve request and revision evidence, and optionally apply declared local EPRS pitch treatment without uploading a human reference voice.

workflows.label: Optional MiniMax Music 3 CUDA collaboration
workflows.description: Generate a structured song through an explicitly operated MiniMax Music 3 CUDA sidecar, then return the source WAV and license-aware provenance to EPRS.

workflows.label: Optional animal-to-melody study
workflows.description: Analyze a preserved animal call with an available pitch-to-MIDI tool, compare the raw call with a chord-aware musical response, and keep analysis separate from release audio.

workflows.label: Optional singing voice laboratory
workflows.description: Compare local singing conversion and note-controlled synthesis candidates while preserving the source vocal, model provenance, and rights evidence.

workflows.label: Optional stem repair laboratory
workflows.description: Separate a checksummed parent mix into tentative stems for repair or alternate arrangement without treating model isolation as clean or destructive editing.

workflows.label: iNaturalist sound to creative study
workflows.description: Freeze a licensed iNaturalist sound reference, measure its acoustic contour, and expose separate beat, noise, lyric, vocal, and tone prompts with provenance and interpretation limits.

workflows.label: Source recording to lossless master
workflows.description: Preserve supplied performances, bind consequential decisions to exact evidence, develop reversibly, and create an approved lossless master.

workflows.label: DAW-neutral arrangement handoff
workflows.description: Export a verified working mix as common-start lossless float stems, then capture a declared lossless DAW return for review and mastering.

workflows.label: Promptable visual production
workflows.description: Develop and render local promptable visuals, then preserve renderer-neutral picture candidates for review.

workflows.label: Optional ChatCut visual handoff
workflows.description: Prepare disposable derivatives and an exact prompt/asset manifest for an explicitly operated ChatCut visual pass, then return only an untrusted picture candidate for local EPRS review.

workflows.label: Optional open-source local visual editing
workflows.description: Use an installed open-source timeline editor for local rough cuts, captions, manual review, and editable project files without an account or cloud upload.

workflows.label: Local YouTube release preparation
workflows.description: Prepare an approved master with either a title card or reviewed renderer-neutral picture, thumbnail/caption/chapter assets, a rights-aware FINAL package, and exact offline uploader inputs without uploading.

workflows.label: Local Spotify and Apple Music handoff
workflows.description: Prepare an approved lossless master, square artwork, credits, identifiers, and public-rights evidence for a separately authorized distributor submission.

workflows.label: Full local production
workflows.description: Run the complete local prompt-and-recordings-to-YouTube-handoff workflow, including recurring agent work and visuals.
